dogecoin.text:
@cb_doge A coin that generates memes.
 You create memes and receive payments in Dogecoin as support.
Good memes receive support, which leads to the production of more good memes.
Will this create a new profession?

@cb_doge Let's use Dogecoin to reward users with good memes. 
That way, they'll create a lot of great memes, don't you think?
@cb_doge How about making it so that people have to pay with Dogecoin to publicly express their thoughts?
